campaign.title: M2 hard-TOP residual oscillatory determinant source-interface gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit only exact primary-source hypotheses needed for the frozen determinant interface. A determinant skeleton or structural analogy is not theorem applicability.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact even-shift, opposing-displacement, low-divisor-gcd residual Fejer aggregate at R_0=ceil(L) be proved at L^2X^epsilon through one selector-aware oscillatory variable-determinant transform, or where is the first exact source-class or restored-power obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Prove Re C_{R_0,2,opp,g<gamma L}^{rem} <<_{gamma,epsilon} L^2 X^epsilon, with R_0=ceil(L), after the literal opening d'm'-dm=r. Preserve exact multiplicity, the actual residual selector, chi_4 twist, even shifts, opposing tangent displacements, low divisor gcd, square-root phase, Fejer weight, endpoints, and one outer real part.
quantities: The exact opened-incidence positive capacity is L^3X^epsilon; the target needs one factor L of genuine signed cancellation.
The determinant dictionary is [[d',d],[m,m']] with determinant r and must be multiplicity preserving.
After r=hk, k=2^{v_2(r)}, the preliminary determinant, two-adic gcd, and fixed chi_4 seams are compatible but do not constitute a theorem application.
The first currently identified source gap is the absence of a proved admissible automorphic or smooth representation of the selector-dependent multiplier.

Conditional phase smoothing requires delta^{-1} >= 1+Jr/L up to constants, while variable-r aggregation, the principal main term, K_+, residual correlation norms, cells, endpoints, and completion remain unpriced.
A fixed-r theorem followed by triangle inequality is forbidden because the target real part is outside the full shift aggregate.
Even success closes only the complete residual scalar; every parent and both exponent ledgers remain separate.

completion_criteria: Derive an exact multiplicity-preserving determinant or orbit dictionary for every retained residual incidence.
Test a literal admissible representation of the actual selector, character, phase, Fejer factor, parity/gcd sector, endpoints, and variable determinant in one aggregate.
Audit every coefficient, automorphy, smoothness, determinant, gcd, support, quantifier, and absolute-value hypothesis of each invoked primary theorem.
Restore every phase-seminorm, main-term, K_+, residual-norm, two-adic, Mobius, cell, hard-crossing, endpoint, and completion cost to the L^2X^epsilon target.
Identify the actual selector or character feature that defeats the phase-aligned filter-erased control; do not infer this from arbitrary arrays alone.
Pass statement-only independence, source applicability, multiplicity, power/endpoint, and downstream graph-scope reviews.
Close under exactly one label: hard_top_t1_residual_short_shift_target, strict_oscillatory_determinant_sector, or oscillatory_determinant_interface_no_go.

review_seams.requirement: Verify every residual incidence, determinant map, parity/gcd branch, selector, and multiplicity with no erased endpoint or duplicate orbit.
Verify exact source hypotheses, coefficient class, smoothness, phase seminorms, variable-r aggregation, and absolute-value placement.

closing_assessment.main_result: The literal residual has an exact multiplicity-one determinant and endpoint-kernel representation with L^3X^epsilon Schur capacity. Every fixed-B polylogarithmic shift sector is target-safe. The non-polylogarithmic K17a range remains open, and the audited direct 2024, fixed-shift-triangle, and current Part-I interfaces do not certify it.
